G O R O R O B A · Q U A N T U M
THE CIRCUIT — OPERATIONS IN TIME ORDER
One illustrative logical route (I – P1 – P2 – D). Numbers for all paths appear at right.
No conditional gate acts on D.
B_D is the measurement-basis rotation, NOT the inverse of input preparation.
No physical feed-forward in Tuna-17; receiver is measured before offline decoding.
No output state surviving into a subsequent quantum operation was demonstrated.
Input-specific decoded match (raw; no SPAM mitigation)
16,384 shots per circuit · four routes, not one channel.
The 11.6-point range cannot isolate input sensitivity
from gate, routing, coherence, or readout differences.
Four basis-specific terminal correlations are measured.
No common-channel six-state average is established.
No live corrected state or inter-processor link is shown.
Run all six ±X, ±Y, ±Z inputs on EACH fixed route.
Randomize order; log T₁/T₂, gate calibration and readout.
Estimate per-route fidelity against the correct 2/3 benchmark.
Test live output with a downstream quantum operation.
